findings.claim_text: GPT-5.6 Sol is listed at $2.50/$15 (50% off) on OpenRouter's OpenAI provider endpoint as of Aug 18, 2026.
GPT-5.6 Sol Standard on OpenAI's own API is $5.00/$30.00 per million tokens as of Aug 18, 2026.

The channel-locked 50% discount on GPT-5.6 Sol (OpenRouter and Vercel only, direct API unchanged) indicates OpenAI is pricing to win token share in third-party routing channels rather than responding to a demand curve on its own API.
findings.contradicting_quote: OpenAI recently slashed the price of its GPT-5.6 Luna model by 80%... Then something striking happened: Customers started using dramatically more AI... usage rose faster than prices fell.
